findings.issue: task requirement R6 is not met on screen 'dashboard_with_mileage': The Recent activity list must be scrollable past the Receipt and Mileage add buttons, allowing the buttons to remain fixed while the list scrolls. Seen in the screenshot: The 'Receipt' and 'Mileage' buttons are not fixed at the bottom of the screen; they are overlaid on the 'Recent activity' list and appear to be part of a dropdown menu that is partially obscuring the list items, indicating they are not fixed while the list scrolls.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

findings.issue: task requirement R7 is not met on screen 'dashboard_populated': On a device with a screen resolution of 390x844 pixels, all bottom tab labels (Dashboard, Receipts, Mileage, Settings) must be fully visible without truncation. Seen in the screenshot: The bottom navigation labels sit at the very bottom edge and are vertically clipped: 'Dashboard', 'Receipts', 'Mileage' and 'Settings' have their lower portions (including the descender of the 'p' in 'Receipts' and 'g' in 'Mileage') cut off by the screen edge, so the text is not fully visible.
findings.fix: Change the screen so the requirement holds exactly as written.

summary: Lean mode: the validators check the UI (render, styles, accessibility, the whole UI flow); no vision review or polish phase.
